title: Supported quasi-coherent derived category is generated by a perfect object
statement: Let Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let V be a quasi-compact open subscheme of Y, and put T=Y\setminus V. There is a perfect complex E [def-pc-perfect-complex] on Y whose cohomology sheaves are supported on T such that every object Q of D_QCoh(Y) [def-pc-derived-category] whose cohomology sheaves are supported on T is the derived colimit of a sequence 0=Q_0\to Q_1\to Q_2\to\cdots in D_QCoh(Y) in which each cone of Q_n\to Q_{n+1} is a direct sum of shifts of E.

source.place: Tag 0E4G (Lemma 48.4.3), proof; Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.15.4 and Derived Categories, Lemma 13.37.3

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-supported-perfect-generator] to X=Y and T=Y\setminus V. It gives a perfect complex E whose cohomology is supported on T and which generates the full subcategory of D_QCoh(Y) consisting of complexes supported on T.

source.place: Tag 0E4G, proof of Lemma 48.4.3(3), invocation of Derived Categories of Schemes Lemma 36.15.4

proof.text: The supported subcategory is a full triangulated subcategory of D_QCoh(Y): it is closed under shifts, and under cones because in the long exact cohomology sequence of a distinguished triangle a sheaf between two sheaves supported on T is supported on T. It has set-indexed direct sums computed in D_QCoh(Y) [lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums], and these are the ambient direct sums of D(\mathcal O_Y), whose cohomology sheaves are the direct sums of the cohomology sheaves [lem-pc-derived-ambient-direct-sums]; so support on T is preserved. The complex E is compact in D_QCoh(Y) by [lem-pc-perfect-object-compact], hence compact in the supported full subcategory because its coproducts are the same ambient coproducts. Since E generates that subcategory in the sense of [def-pc-generators], the singleton family consisting of E is a set of compact objects whose coproduct is a generator there.

source.place: Tag 0E4G, proof of Lemma 48.4.3(3), closure of the supported subcategory under direct sums

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-compact-generators-build-objects] to the supported subcategory and the singleton compact generating family {E}. For each supported Q it gives a sequence X_1\to X_2\to\cdots whose telescope, formed with coproducts of the supported subcategory and hence also in D_QCoh(Y), is Q, with X_1 a coproduct of shifts of E and each transition cone a coproduct of shifts of E. Set Q_0=0 and Q_{n+1}=X_{n+1}; the cone of Q_0\to Q_1 is X_1, so the same property holds for every transition. The telescope is unchanged by adjoining the initial zero object, yielding the required sequence 0=Q_0\to Q_1\to Q_2\to\cdots.

source.place: Tag 0E4G, proof of Lemma 48.4.3(3), application of Derived Categories Lemma 13.37.3
